question: What do the FAA guidance and drone manuals say should happen when a connection is lost, and what do the available incident reports add or leave uncertain?
stop_reason: claims still failing after the revision limit

intake.focus: lost link guidance and incident reports
intake.reason: Seek FAA guidance and manuals on behavior during connection loss and what incident reports add or leave uncertain.

brief.short_answer: FAA guidance claims that if the remote-control link is not reestablished, emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control should be initiated, that operators should attempt to reestablish the control link, and that preflight briefings must include control link loss procedures. Manufacturer manuals for Matrice 30T/4T describe failsafe RTH or hover/land options on signal loss, with RTH altitude intended to clear obstacles and various recovery paths if the controller reconnects. Incident reports (unverified) cite lost-link events with RTH or return-to-home outcomes, including crashes or control loss during takeoff, and some accounts claim a link restoration or continued loss effects are observed.

claims.text: When the remote control link is not reestablished, start emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link.
claims.quote: If connection cannot be reestablished, start emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link.

claims.text: If a loss of control link occurs, try to reestablish control link connection with the small unmanned aircraft.
claims.quote: Try to reestablish control link connection with the small unmanned aircraft.

claims.text: The preflight briefing must include control link loss procedures.
claims.quote: The preflight briefing must include control link loss procedures.

claims.text: When the remote controller signal is lost, the action of the aircraft can be set to RTH, land, or hover.
claims.quote: The action of the aircraft when the remote controller signal is lost can be set to RTH, land, or hover
conditions: If the remote controller signal is lost

claims.text: If RTH is chosen, lighting being sufficient allows the RTH path to be displayed and the aircraft will start RTH using Advanced RTH, remaining in RTH even if the signal is restored.
claims.quote: When the lighting is sufficient and the vision systems are working normally, DJI Pilot 2 will display the RTH path that was generated by the aircraft before the remote controller signal was lost.
conditions: If the action is set to RTH

claims.text: If lighting is insufficient and vision systems are unavailable, the aircraft will enter Original Route RTH, and it will enter Preset RTH if the remote controller signal is restored during Original Route RTH.
claims.quote: When the lighting is not sufficient and the vision systems are not available, the aircraft will enter Original Route RTH. The aircraft enters Preset RTH if the remote controller signal is restored during Original Route RTH.
conditions: remote controller signal restored during Original Route RTH

claims.text: If the disconnected remote controller reconnects during the flight, it will not resume its previous control and will by default have no control of any device.
claims.quote: If the disconnected remote controller reconnects with the aircraft during the flight, it will not resume its previous control and will by default have no control of any device.

claims.text: The RTH altitude should be higher than any obstacle in the area to prevent collisions during failsafe RTH.
claims.quote: The RTH altitude is related to the Home Point. Make sure the RTH altitude is higher than any obstacle in the area.

claims.text: When the remote controller signal is lost, the aircraft will automatically initiate Failsafe RTH if the Signal Lost Action is set to RTH.
claims.quote: Loss of remote controller signal When the remote controller signal is lost, the aircraft will automatically initiate Failsafe RTH if the Signal Lost Action is set to RTH.
conditions: Signal Lost Action is set to RTH

claims.text: If lighting and environment conditions are unsuitable for the vision system, the aircraft will brake and hover, then enter Original Route RTH.
claims.quote: When the lighting and environment conditions are unsuitable for the vision system, the aircraft will brake and hover, then enter Original Route RTH.
conditions: lighting and environment unsuitable for vision system

claims.text: RTH can be triggered in three ways: the user actively triggers RTH, the aircraft has low battery, or the remote controller signal has been lost (Failsafe RTH is triggered).
claims.quote: RTH can be triggered in three ways: the user actively triggers RTH, the aircraft has low battery, or the remote controller signal has been lost (Failsafe RTH is triggered).

claims.text: If the RTH distance is farther than 50 m, the aircraft adjusts its orientation and flies backward for 50 m on its original flight route before entering Preset RTH.
claims.quote: If the RTH distance (the horizontal distance between the aircraft and the Home Point) is farther than 50 m, the aircraft adjusts its orientation and flies backward for 50 m on its original flight route before entering Preset RTH.

claims.text: The AR RTH route is only used for reference, and may deviate from the actual flight route in different scenarios.
claims.quote: The AR RTH route is only used for reference, and may deviate from the actual flight route in different scenarios.

claims.text: During automated flight missions, if the connection between the drone and the remote controller is lost, Only then will the drone execute the preset Signal Loss Action.
claims.quote: Only then will the drone execute the preset Signal Loss Action.
conditions: connection between the drone and the remote controller is lost

claims.text: If the link is restored within 10 seconds after disconnection, control will automatically return to the remote controller.
claims.quote: If the link is restored within 10 seconds after disconnection, control will automatically return to the remote controller.
conditions: link is restored within 10 seconds after disconnection

claims.text: When the C2 link is lost, both the Autel Enterprise App and the remote controller will issue real-time voice alerts to notify the user.
claims.quote: When the C2 link is lost, both the Autel Enterprise App and the remote controller will issue real-time voice alerts to notify the user.

claims.text: The manual states that if the Home Point was successfully recorded and the compass is functioning normally, Failsafe RTH will be automatically activated if the remote controller signal is lost for more than three seconds.
claims.quote: If the Home Point was successfully recorded and the compass is functioning normally, Failsafe RTH will be automatically activated if the remote controller signal is lost for more than three seconds.
conditions: remote controller signal lost for more than three seconds

claims.text: The manual states that the aircraft will plan its return route and retrace its original flight route home, and the user may cancel Failsafe RTH to regain control when connection is reestablished.
claims.quote: The aircraft will plan its return route and retrace its original flight route home.

claims.text: The manual states that the aircraft will automatically descend and land if RTH is triggered when the aircraft flies within a 65 feet (20 meters) radius of the Home Point.
claims.quote: The aircraft will automatically descend and land if RTH is triggered when the aircraft flies within a 65 feet (20 meters) radius of the Home Point.

claims.text: The manual states that the user may cancel Failsafe RTH to regain control when connection is reestablished.
claims.quote: The user may cancel Failsafe RTH to regain control when connection is reestablished.

claims.quote: Lost link and RTH occurred twice on back-to-back hops.

claims.quote: went into a lost link and returned home within 10 seconds of the glitching screen
